paragraphs: Founded in 2001, Citrine One Malaysia is a strategic communications and crisis communications consultancy serving corporate organisations, government and SMEs. Its work brings together experienced communications counsel, stakeholder understanding and a journalist’s view of how stories travel.
With operations in Kuala Lumpur and Penang and a regional network, Citrine works across reputation, leadership, research and social impact.

people.name: Ivlynn Yap
people.portraitAlt: Ivlynn Yap, Group Executive Chairman of Citrine
biography: Ivlynn brings more than 30 years of experience across journalism, regional marketing communications, public relations, stakeholder engagement and crisis communications. She founded Citrine One and returned to lead the group in 2024.

Her career has included reporting and editorial roles at The Star, Asia Computer Weekly and Asia Pacific Telecommunications; regional marketing communications at AMD; editorial, production and business development at CNET; and communications leadership at Perbadanan Insurans Deposit Malaysia (PIDM).

biography: Redza is a digital transformation professional and author with more than 17 years of experience across finance, technology and the public sector. His work has included digital adoption, technology strategy and digitalisation initiatives.

His career includes digital adoption and cloud initiatives at Khazanah Nasional, partnership groundwork for the United Nations Technology Innovation Lab in Malaysia (UNTIL), and policy and industry development work at Malaysia’s Multimedia Development Corporation (MDEC).
